canonical_anchor.name: Accepted Veklom proof-and-seal continuum
canonical_anchor.rule: The Capability OS is the integrated expression of the accepted proven/sealed continuum. A release candidate is downstream packaging and may not redefine, shrink, or downgrade the anchor.

RC1.rule: RC1 is not the proof anchor and may not be used to invalidate already accepted scoped seals.

order: independently verified consequence/state at the real sink

consequence_authority.rule: No V-Chip gate, lab gate, proxy, payment rail, PGL service, or new subsystem may become a second ALLOW/DENY consequence authority.

ownership.vchip_role: Authority-lineage and stale-incarnation falsification lineage that must be integrated through CAPPO rather than wired beside it.
ownership.virtualdb_role: Governed state-continuity/materialization lineage. The real local VirtualDB source must be exported canonically; virtualdb-stub is not an implementation.

hard_invariants.implementation_rule: Copied code, runtime, state, or historical credentials must not by themselves grant the right to cause the next governed consequence.

hard_invariants.expression: AcceptedEffect => Identity ∧ Policy ∧ OperationSpecificAuthority ∧ CurrentTargetState ∧ ExecutionBoundary ∧ DurableEvidence
hard_invariants.implementation_rule: These are hard gates, not a weighted score.
PGL/GnomLedger records and verifies; it does not silently become consequence authority.
When authority advances, a computationally complete stale incarnation must be denied at the consequence boundary under the tested binding model.
Integration candidates must conform to the continuum; they do not redefine it.
Cold coding agents must resolve architecture nouns to existing canonical repositories before writing new subsystems.

proof_programs.claim_scope: Independent Hyper-V guest/runtime manifestations on one physical Windows host; controlled vNIC cut; lease/epoch handoff; stale-host and wrong-runtime denial; receipt/PGL continuity.
establishes: execution manifestation can move while governed authority advances
boot/runtime possession is not sufficient for current consequence authority
stale authority is fenced in the tested Hyper-V conditions
boundaries: does not by itself prove two physical motherboards or TPM/hardware-root equivalence
temporal conformance defects identified in earlier Windows/Alpine runs must stay scoped to the affected runs

proof_programs.claim_scope: Governed state survived source-runtime termination, moved in a self-contained package, rejected tamper/source-authority/stale-epoch cases, and resumed under fresh destination authority with state/provenance continuity.
establishes: state continuity can be separated from a particular runtime manifestation
fresh destination authority can rebind a moved state package
stale/source authority does not automatically follow copied state
boundaries: does not establish arbitrary-cloud or arbitrary-Kubernetes portability
does not establish universal exactly-once behavior for every target

proof_programs.claim_scope: Single-host independent-process state/evidence continuity with epoch 1→2 handoff, FENCE_DENY/STALE_DENY behavior, runtime-bound denial, and receipt/PGL chaining.
establishes: state/evidence continuity under controlled handoff
stale writer rejection and monotonic authority handoff
boundaries: canonical repository linkage for the historical bundle still needs hash migration
single-host process separation is not a two-motherboard proof

proof_programs.claim_scope: Real PostgreSQL 16-alpine consequence sink; paused Epoch-N writer raced against promotion to Epoch N+1; stale COMMIT rejected by SERIALIZABLE; protected_data independently read back empty.
establishes: a stale writer can be fenced at an independent database consequence boundary
absence of the forbidden mutation was independently verified
evidence_refs: isolated PostgreSQL sink on host port 5433 during test
boundaries: this proves the tested PostgreSQL race, not universal database semantics
exact artifact hashes must be migrated into the canonical evidence registry

proof_programs.claim_scope: CAPPO fail-closed governed consequence path including bounded mount authority, server-side token custody, allow/deny, replay handling, termination and post-termination denial, and durable evidence linkage.
establishes: CAPPO is the sole canonical consequence authority
authority is bounded and fail-closed on tested paths
pre-effect denial can prevent target invocation on tested paths
boundaries: do not treat every historical harness as a production deployment proof
public contracts must carry all required incarnation/epoch evidence into existing CAPPO enforcement

proof_programs.claim_scope: Product-0 contract/adversarial invariants and contract conformance battery, including explicit authority, replay, custody, outcome and reconciliation semantics.
establishes: canonical fail-closed consequence-dispatch contract behavior under the tested battery
boundaries: contract conformance is not by itself deployment proof

proof_programs.claim_scope: Identity/evidence schema and execution-identity binding work across WID-1 through WID-6.
establishes: identity-side evidence contracts used by governed execution
boundaries: schema correctness does not imply hardware identity attestation unless independently demonstrated

proof_programs.claim_scope: 15-step lifecycle and hostile battery exercised in the conformance harness; historical reported suite 478/478 with mock-linux VALID and hostile denials.
establishes: reproducible invariant-test machinery and hostile test coverage
boundaries: mock/demo success is harness proof, not physical substrate proof
physical claims require the corresponding live consequence boundary

proof_programs.claim_scope: Local CAPPO→n8n→governed target→PostgreSQL chain with cancel/safe retry behavior, restart recovery and secret redaction; later consequence-sink work included local GnomLedger/PGL evidence.
establishes: multi-service governed consequence integration on the tested local chain
boundaries: local chain proof is not the same as a public production deployment

proof_programs.claim_scope: Bounded local harness for destination-scoped, byte-budgeted, replay-resistant TCP movement with mid-transfer revocation, single-use semantics and receiver-side evidence.
establishes: NetworkCapability can govern a bounded transfer under the tested harness
boundaries: does not prove virtualized physical bandwidth or arbitrary network fabrics
physical cross-host transport must be graded separately

proof_programs.claim_scope: Verified destination state plus missing authorized ranges reconstruct the requested root while distinguishing logical bytes from physical bytes.
establishes: governed reconstruction can reduce moved bytes when authoritative state is already present
boundaries: does not imply zero-cost or infinite-bandwidth transport

proof_programs.claim_scope: Earth/Mars and stale-incarnation experiments support separation between computational possession and current consequence authority under the tested V-Chip lineage.
establishes: same/copy-equivalent computational state need not imply the right to produce the next governed consequence
epoch/holder/key/replay bindings are useful falsification dimensions
boundaries: vchip-lab intake contains E2/self-reported artifacts and is not by itself the sole evidence source for accepted cross-host claims
vchip-lab must not be wired as a second authority beside CAPPO
the four-file virtualdb-stub is not the real VirtualDB implementation

proof_programs.claim_scope: VFRAC process/federation/depth/endurance experiments establish scoped execution-lineage and hierarchy behavior; OS-correlated claims are accepted where independent telemetry exists, while large-scale proof JSON alone remains self-reported evidence.
establishes: execution manifestation can be treated separately from current authority
bounded hierarchical/federated lineage can be exercised across tested depths
endurance degradation must be separated from observer/launcher failure
boundaries: do not extrapolate harness scale into universal containment claims
independent OS/kernel correlation is required for physical execution claims
million-scale self-reported JSON is not equivalent to million independently observed physical workers

proof_programs.claim_scope: Capability OS composes identity continuity, capability scope, current consequence authority, execution manifestation, state continuity and evidence continuity without collapsing them into one object.
establishes: the system must integrate the accepted proof estate rather than selecting a smaller release-candidate subset
proof scope is preserved per program while architecture composes the surviving invariants
boundaries: composition does not upgrade any constituent proof beyond its stated tested conditions

integration_requirements: Every coding task must identify which continuum invariant(s) and proof program(s) it preserves, wires, or extends.
If implementation lacks a public/runtime path for an already established invariant, the task is an integration gap, not permission to invent a replacement subsystem.
CAPPO public consequence contracts must carry the incarnation/epoch fields required by CAPPO's existing enforcement when those bindings are in scope.
Capability OS surfaces must render proof state from real evidence/registries and never synthesize production proof.
Existing accepted seals must be hash-linked into the canonical evidence registry rather than recreated from prose.
The real VirtualDB source must be exported from the canonical local tree before any agent treats VirtualDB as source-integrated.
V-Chip and VFRAC research code may supply mechanisms/tests, but authority decisions integrate through CAPPO and evidence closes through GnomLedger/PGL.
